claims.text: Clinician note records that the patient is allergic to penicillin, with a widespread rash in 2019.

citations.quote: Allergic to penicillin; widespread rash in 2019.

open_questions: When was the penicillin allergy first recorded, and what reactions were documented at that time? The record only contains a clinician note dated 2026-08-02 describing a 2019 rash; no earlier allergy entry is present.
Were any allergy entries later revised, removed or reassessed after the 2019 rash? No revision or reassessment entry appears in the record.
What symptoms were recorded in earlier entries that explain the recent note of feeling fine? No earlier symptom entries are present in the record.
The record contains no entries documenting medications started, stopped, held or changed.
The record contains no follow-up, referral or test entries, so planned or outstanding items cannot be determined.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Documented penicillin allergy with a prior widespread rash is a high-risk allergy for future antibiotic prescribing.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm the penicillin allergy and reaction details with the patient and ensure it is visible before any antibiotic is ordered.
